subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch completes with replies=0 even though assistant final text is written to session transcript

question: Should Feishu/channel final delivery recover current-turn transcript-owned assistant text when `replyResult` is empty or suppressed, and what privacy/deduping constraints must apply?
rationale: The source path confirms the reported missing recovery, but deciding whether transcript final text may bypass source-reply suppression is a product and privacy boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define shared durable recovery first
options.body: Keep this issue open under #87561, define current-turn transcript recovery and explicit delivery outcomes once, then make Feishu conform to that contract.

options.title: Allow narrow Feishu recovery
options.body: Permit a Feishu-only fix if it proves the transcript text belongs to the same turn and preserves idempotency, intentional silence, and source-reply suppression tests.

options.title: Do not recover transcript finals
options.body: Keep the generic no-visible fallback and improve diagnostics only, accepting that transcript-owned final text is not a channel delivery source.

recommendation.title: Define shared durable recovery first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under #87561, define current-turn transcript recovery and explicit delivery outcomes once, then make Feishu conform to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The open maintainer contract issue #87561 is the broad product decision that should constrain a Feishu-specific fix.
